project_type: Full-stack TypeScript app (Express + Vite React) with PostgreSQL-compatible DB via better-sqlite3
build_system: pnpm for dependencies, vite for client build, esbuild for server bundle
build_command: pnpm run build (vite build + esbuild server)
verification_instructions: 1. Run pnpm run check (TypeScript type checking). 2. Run pnpm run test. 3. Use Playwright to login to adaptly.co.uk and verify worksheet generation works with library worksheets.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Node v22.22.3 available via nvm. Python 3.11.14 via pyenv. Playwright + Chromium available for E2E testing.
contribution_requirements: Worksheets in worksheet-library/worksheets/maths/ follow SCHEMA.md format. Topic names must match SUBTOPICS_MAP keys in client/src/lib/subtopics-data.ts. Sections must have stable ids (s1..sN, ts1..tsN). Section types must use canonical types from SCHEMA.md.
key_patterns: 1. Source JSON format has: title (TOPIC,\n(SUBTOPIC)), objective, info_boxes, modelled_examples[4], practice[5], misconceptions, challenge. 2. Target library format has: subject, topic, subtopic, yearGroup, tier, title, subtitle, learning_objective, key_vocab[], sections[], teacher_sections[]. 3. The overlay engine (server/lib/overlayEngine.ts) applies SEND overlays by inserting support sections after question sections - never modifies base content. 4. Library lookup uses subject+topic+yearGroup+tier with fuzzy matching via canonicalTopicKey(). 5. The resolve endpoint applies overlays including sendNeed and readingAge. 6. Existing example: worksheet-library/worksheets/maths/simultaneous-equations__non-linear-simultaneous-equations.json shows exact target format.
relevant_files: server/routes/worksheetLibrary.ts (library API routes - lookup, resolve, auto-save)
directory_structure: Root: package.json, server/, client/, maths-worksheets/, worksheet-library/, worksheet-factory/. Server: routes/worksheetLibrary.ts, lib/overlayEngine.ts, lib/topicNormalizer.ts, db/index.ts. Client: src/pages/Worksheets.tsx, src/lib/subtopics-data.ts, src/components/WorksheetRenderer.tsx. Maths-worksheets: json/ (128 files), pdf/ (128 files), scripts/. Worksheet-library: SCHEMA.md, worksheets/maths/ (1 file currently).
